component.name: Quake3 Demo
component.summary: Quake 3 Arena tournament 3D shooter game demo installer

description.p: Quake 3 Arena tournament 3D shooter game demo installer. The Quake3 engine is Open Source. The original Quake3 datafiles however are not Open Source. There is a gratis, but not Open Source demo available on the internet.
This package installs an applications menu entry for playing the Quake3 Arena Demo. The first time you click this menu entry, it will offer to download and install the Quake 3 Demo datafiles for you.
